hooks.text: 以“记忆”为施法组件，可组合和重排素材，现场拼出雷暴、冰冻龙卷等自定义法术。
hooks.excerpt: Thunderbursts, freezing tornadoes, fire vortices. If you can imagine it, you can craft it. Memories are your only weapon against the Shadows of the Past. Combine them, reorder them, and watch your spell take shape right in front of you.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 每条路线配置不同挑战、遭遇与奖励，让玩家自主决定一局中的推进路径。
hooks.excerpt: Every path has its challenges, its encounters, and its rewards. And your journey is yours to command.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 世界记忆正被裂隙吞噬，守望者需面对战争与剥削留下的历史创伤并找出隐藏真相。
hooks.excerpt: A Rift has opened in the Cycle of Memories. As a Watcher, it falls to you to save the World’s Memory. Divinities, primordial Guardians, and peoples scarred by war and exploitation: a vast world unfolds before you. Only you can uncover its hidden truths.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 法术组合快速且可随时调整，便于尝试不同组合。

excerpts.excerpt: combining spells is fast and is never locked in so you can try all sorts of combos
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 法术构筑动作肉鸽玩法非常出色。
故事能推动玩家反复游玩。

excerpts.excerpt: a story that keeps you playing again and again.
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段
